# ProductWindow

This directory stores project-specific coordination records for ProductWindow.

- Window responsibility: Project repository; confirm scope and responsibility before enabling.
- Source repository scope: `../ProductWorkspace`
- Keep source code changes in the source repository.
- Keep durable window-specific handoff conclusions and responsibility history here.
- Lifecycle: append-only responsibility history; never demand authority.
- Do not place requirement definitions, goal/stage decisions, or workspace-wide plans here.
